Why your model overfits

Overfitting is the most common problem in small-data machine learning. Here is how to spot it.

Check your validation curve

If validation loss rises while training loss falls, you are overfitting.

Conclusion

Use cross-validation, simpler models and more data augmentation before reaching for bigger networks.

Above all, always keep a held-out test set you never tune on.

Goodfellow et al. 2016.
